topic: Introduction to aircraft structural principles, general assumptions in engineering theory
syllabus_extract: Introduction to aircraft structural principles, general assumptions in engineering theory. methods by which structure carries load, typical ideal bending movement and shear force diagram.
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of structural element diagrams from IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft structure?
Name three common structural elements found in an aircraft.
Define the term 'load' in the context of aircraft engineering.

development.content:
Definition of aircraft structure
General assumptions in engineering theory
Methods of load carrying
Structural elements and details

Typical ideal bending movement
Shear force diagram concepts
Load distribution principles
Stress and strain basics

Application of structural principles
Review of load carrying methods
Summary of bending and shear
Connection to fuselage design

summary_questions: Explain how a structure carries load using the methods discussed.
Describe the relationship between bending movement and shear force.
List the general assumptions used in aircraft structural theory.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the structural principles covered in this lesson apply to the fuselage design discussed in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: Fuselage introduction, fuselage shape, structural design, detailed design layout
